slot.brief: Ask the opposite of a simple, high-frequency adjective; options are all plausible antonym-style words but only one is correct.

stem:
Choose the word opposite in meaning to the word given in capital letters.

**SCARCE**

verdicts.working: “Scarce” means insufficient or rare; its opposite is “abundant.”

working:
Scarce means available in small quantity. Abundant means available in large quantity, so it is the opposite. Limited, rare and insufficient are similar in meaning to scarce.
